node.statement: The constants in (1.1)-(1.3) give C_R>0, and 0<=eta<=(2*C_R)^(-1) gives 0<=C_R*eta<=1/2. Node 1.3 therefore yields ||C_j||>=1-C_R*eta>=1/2. An operator on the zero Hilbert space has norm zero, so E_j is nonzero; because E_j is finite-dimensional, the positive contraction C_j attains its norm at some unit vector xi_j, with ||C_j xi_j||=||C_j||.
